answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The lotus holds work receipts rather than names, so the vine of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the voyage of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, expired if not renewed by fresh work, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work.
